headline: Two oil tankers hit by mines in Strait of Hormuz
summary: Two oil tankers were struck by naval mines and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday. Iran's Revolutionary Guards Navy stated the vessels were attempting to transit an unauthorized route.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a critical chokepoint for global oil transit. Any disruption or security incident in this area typically triggers volatility in global energy prices.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Geopolitical tensions in a major oil transit chokepoint typically increase supply risk premiums.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The incident raises concerns about the safety of oil shipments through a vital global maritime route, potentially restricting supply.
